decision.explanation: The sources explicitly state two distinct positions held by Simon Hernesby. Document 1 (D1S2, D1S3) confirms his current appointment as 'Archbishop of Santiago de Chile'. Document 2 (D2S3) describes him as the 'diocesan bishop of the Roman Catholic Church' (specifically in the context of Ashwood). The other candidates (C3-C14) are either descriptive titles ('respected bishop'), metaphorical phrases ('beacon of hope', 'servant of the Lord'), or refer to other individuals (Cardinal Jorge Medina, Maria Rodriguez), and thus do not represent the specific positions requested.
